Periods have always been so difficult for me for variety of reasons. Extremely heavy flow, mood swings,
anger/feeling it will never end, and horrible anxiety that things are not going the way they’re supposed to. I’m constantly worried whether the smallest thing can be a sign of TSS or anything threatening and abnormal. Pinkllama has so many fun illustrated small books on different subjects such as what things to avoid eating and what things to eat during periods, how to help calm down your anger when on your period, and information on TSS and how to prevent it along with so much more. The system for tracking the dates of each day you’re on your period and the symptoms that go along with each day is so easy to use/look back at in case you need to track how your mood/other period symptom and your period dates have changed in the past _____ amount of time. I’ve only been using it for a (relatively) small amount of time but as I have seen so far, It’s actually very very accurate at predicting when you’re next period starts/ends and sends you adorable reminders to let you know so you can prepare.
